alt: Architectural rendering of the MUNA Quito competition-winning design — a massive pale concrete cube with irregularly-spaced rectangular window cutouts on its facade, set in a city block next to La Carolina Park with Quito's mountains visible in the background
credit: Studio Campo Baeza / MAODA via ArchDaily
story: Studio Campo Baeza and MAODA won an international competition to design Ecuador's new National Museum with 'Echoes of the Sun' — announced July 6, 2026 — but within days 20,000 Ecuadorians signed a petition comparing the concrete block to a cardboard box and DoodleBob from SpongeBob, the Vice Minister of Culture resigned, and the government 'recalled' the winning design.
why_funny: 148 architecture teams from 20+ countries competed, an international expert jury crowned a winner, and Ecuador's public response was to circulate a petition calling the proposed national museum a SpongeBob character — and the government agreed.
